items.description: A published app's id (`CatalogApp.id`, the last part of its /app/<id>/ url), e.g. `firefox` or `app.zen_browser.zen`.

title: Store: the homepage's must-have apps
description: The apps of the homepage's hand-picked 'Must-have apps' row, in display order: editorial, as no field of the dataset says what is a must-have. Published as the `listingRows:mustHave` meta row; an id the dataset doesn't list is left out of the row (`pnpm seed` names it).
